name: SIP Phone for Kiosk Satellite
description: Native SIP calling with a floating dialer, direct calls through a configured PBX, and a separate extension for each kiosk.
author: Eibelucas

settings.title: PBX address
settings.description: IPv4 address or hostname of the Asterisk PBX. Call audio is restricted to this resolved address.

settings.title: PBX SIP port
settings.description: SIP port configured on the Asterisk PBX.

settings.title: Device extension
settings.description: Numeric extension configured on the PBX (1–79 digits), such as 100 or 6000. The bundled gateway reserves 600 for its echo test.

settings.title: Device SIP password
settings.description: Password assigned to this extension in the gateway device settings.

settings.title: Bottom offset (dp)
settings.description: Distance from the bottom screen edge, in dp; range 12–300.

settings.title: Language
settings.description: Language of the dialer, call controls and runtime status. Plugin settings use English.
